analysis.original_request: Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (refractive index 1.52, lossless) with air incidence (refractive index 1.0). The stack must consist of exactly one layer of lossless SiO2 (n=1.46) and one layer of lossless TiO2 (n=2.40) in either order. Each layer thickness is constrained between 40 nm and 160 nm. The objective is to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance at normal incidence with s-polarization, sampled from 450 nm to 700 nm in 5 nm steps using deterministic Transfer Matrix Method. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is a soft scoring preference. The optimization allows at most two research rounds with one route and up to 64 solver evaluations per round using seed 17. Decisions to adjust or stop must be based on observed results and independent numeric checks.
analysis.compatibility_reason: The request specifies a planar, laterally uniform, linear, isotropic layered medium under frequency-domain plane-wave illumination, which fits the solver boundary. All materials are lossless and constant-index, and the calculation method (TMM) is supported.
